validation.name: charts
validation.command: rc=0; for c in ansible/argocd/charts/*/; do helm lint "$c" || rc=1; helm template "$(basename "$c")" "$c" >/dev/null || rc=1; done; exit $rc

validation.name: ansible
validation.command: rc=0; for p in plays/*.yml; do ansible-playbook --syntax-check -i localhost, "$p" || rc=1; done; exit $rc
